conclusions.rationale: Nonnegative eigenvalues may equal zero. The one-dimensional zero matrix satisfies symmetry and positive semidefiniteness but is singular.
conclusions.repair: Require strict positive definiteness or a positive lower eigenvalue bound. Treat singular directions separately if the application permits them.
conclusions.counterexample: Take d=1 and A=[0]. Its only eigenvalue and determinant are zero.
